title: They should have just done the second act in the courtyard because I ...
transcript: y'all I may actually be cursed because tonight I went to go see we are gathered which is a new play at Arena Stage by Tarell Alvin Mccraney loved this play at least the first almost first act until the fire alarm went off and they cancelled the rest of the show because there's a faulty fire detector that's two shows two shows on this trip that I have not been able to see the end of unfortunately unlike the last one I'm not gonna be able to reschedule this because I am leaving to go back to New York at 6:00am tomorrow so on the plus side I do get sleep but I am devastated not to see how this play ends and if you are in the DC area please there's only I think one one and a half more weeks left of this run it closes June 15th I need you all to go to this show and tell me how it ends because the first half is so freaking good anyway there you go today tricks is currently running a sale for 23 dollar tickets for the next week maybe until the end of the run so please go see this play for me and let me know and somebody else produced this so I can go see the end of it anyway on the bright side I got to watch the wicked for good trailer in the theater while we were waiting to see what happens so you know not all bad and the first act was really good loved it
classificationReason: Creator attended 'We Are Gathered' at Arena Stage in DC, but this show is not in the provided list. The Wicked mention is only about a trailer seen in passing while waiting.
